title: Was modern art a CIA psy-op? (2020)
summary: This article investigates the controversial theory that the CIA secretly funded and promoted Abstract Expressionism and modern art during the Cold War as a covert psychological operation against the Soviet Union, examining historical documents and testimonies to separate fact from myth.
problem_solved: Debunks or validates the popular conspiracy theory about CIA involvement in shaping modern art as Cold War propaganda
why_valuable: It reveals the complex relationship between art, politics, and cultural diplomacy during the Cold War era, challenging common misconceptions about artistic movements
